# v1 importer golden fixtures: config

GENERATED BY `go run ./internal/migration/golden`. DO NOT HAND EDIT.

Each `config-<16 hex>.json` file is one record the real v1 config importer produced from one digest-pinned input under `internal/migration/v1/testdata/v1-goldens/`, passed through the harvester's allowlist Redactor. The name is the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of the file's canonical JSON (sorted keys, 2-space indent, LF, one trailing newline).

## Redaction policy

Each input is imported in its own scratch home. A record keeps the v2 keys the v1 config translator maps (schema_version, logging.level, logging.format, daemon.socket, telemetry.enabled); an absolute path value becomes REDACTED-PATH and every other key's value is REDACTED, never dropped. A translator refusal (unknown v1 keys) is committed as config-refusal-<hash>.json with the refused key paths instead of being skipped.

## Regenerate

    go run ./internal/migration/golden [--domain config] [--dry-run]

A repeat run over unchanged inputs writes nothing. To extend the input set, add the file under the pinned input dir, add its line to `INPUTS.sha256` (`<sha256>  <path>`, sorted by path), and run the harvester; it refuses any file the manifest does not list or whose digest differs.
